name: Buy4Less Vector
description: Classic corporate dealer — white page with deep-navy full-width bands (utility topbar, vehicle-search band, value-props band, footer), royal-blue CTAs and bold uppercase Montserrat display type. Photo hero with two-line headline, navy search band with make/body/price selects, tabbed inventory showcase, four-point assurance band, finance/trade-in two-panel split and a top-brands strip. Fully token-driven so the dashboard recolours every surface.
